channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: EUR/USD: Inflation-driven stabilisation hopes – ING
item.description: ING FX Strategist Francesco Pesole argues EUR/USD should be trading above 1.140 based on their models, with recent Euro weakness seen as somewhat overdone. He focuses on September Eurozone inflation and ECB communication as key drivers.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecast: Fails at 0.8610 amid higher Oil prices, BoE hawkishness
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has failed to break the 0.8610 resistance level against the British Pound on Monday, sending the EUR/GBP pair back to session lows at 0.8690 at the time of writing.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Hawkish RBA hike expectations – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to deliver a 25bp rate hike to 4.60%, with Governor Bullock likely leaving the door open for further tightening. Persistent inflation concerns, tight labour markets and resilient growth underpin this view.

item.title: Indian Rupee declines as oil prices rise over weekend
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) starts the week on a negative note against the US Dollar (USD) due to significant gains in oil prices over the weekend. As of writing, the USD/INR pair is up 0.15% to near 95.95.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Holds gains above 1.4150, while technicals flag overbought risk
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades in positive territory near 1.4155 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) as hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations build.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Rate support erodes as outflows resume – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan warns that the Indonesian Rupiah remains exposed as US yield increases erode Indonesia’s rate support.

item.title: Gold extends intraday losses below $4,200, fresh low since August 5 on Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) adds to heavy intraday losses, hitting a fresh low since August 5, around the $4,169-$4,168 region heading into the European session on Monday amid a bearish fundamental backdrop.

item.title: Forex Today: Gold slumps below $4,200 on hawkish Fed outlook, Mideast tensions
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, September 28:

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls like house of cards on Fed’s hawkish narrative
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 4.3% to near $61.50 during the European trading session on Monday. The white metal nosedives as elevated United States (US) Treasury Yields have diminished its appeal.

item.title: Euro: Rate uncertainty and energy costs weigh – HSBC
item.description: HSBC sees the Euro facing mounting headwinds from both monetary policy and energy markets.

item.title: Japanese Yen nudges lower despite a hawkish BoJ, intervention warnings
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is trimming gains from Friday’s rebound against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday.

item.title: USD/JPY: Weekly review highlights Dollar strength – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Teppei Ino reviews USD/JPY price action over Japan’s extended holiday week. The pair opened near 157 and traded in a broad 156–159 range as Dollar strength persisted and expectations of a possible earlier Federal Reserve rate hike supported gains.

item.title: India rates: Spreads seen narrowing further – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research strategist Sherilyn Chew contrasts India’s domestic backdrop with Indonesia, arguing India is deeper into a tightening phase. Markets are pricing a possible Reserve Bank of India (RBI) hike in October, with liquidity surplus falling after RBI draining measures.

item.title: US Dollar: Cyclical support and energy resilience – HSBC
item.description: HSBC’s FX Viewpoint argues the broad US Dollar is likely to strengthen modestly in the near term as cyclical, political and structural forces turn more supportive.

item.title: WTI rises above $93.00 after Trump rejects Iran peace deal
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $93.05 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. WTI rises following US President Donald Trump’s rejection of an Iranian peace deal.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Holds ground near 1.3200, near-term bias remains bearish
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.15% at around 1.3245 against the US Dollar (USD) in the early European session on Monday. The GBP/USD pair gains as the British currency outperforms its peers despite market experts questioning hawkish Bank of England (BoE) repricing.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Consolidates above 1.1350 pivotal support as bearish bias persists
item.description: The EUR/USD pair fills a modest weekly bearish gap, though it lacks bullish conviction and struggles below the 1.1400 mark through the Asian session on Monday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah struggles amid foreign-exchange demand, portfolio outflows
item.description: USD/IDR recovers its recent losses from the previous trading day, trading around 17,980 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Asian stocks slip as oil prices rise, India's NIFTY falls below 23,000
item.description: Asian equities mostly trade in negative territory on Monday, pressured by rising oil prices and higher US Treasury yields. Traders doubt that the United States (US) and Iran will reach a ceasefire agreement soon.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Recovers above 110.50, but technical outlook stays bearish
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 110.85, snapping the four-day losing streak during the early European session on Monday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Eyes nine-day EMA barrier near 180.00
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground after registering modest losses the previous day, trading around 179.70 during Asian hours on Monday. Technical analysis of the daily chart shows that the currency cross continues to trade within a descending channel pattern, pointing to a persistent bearish outlook.

item.title: Swiss Franc hits fresh low since May 2025, near 0.8300 vs USD amid Fed-SNB divergence
item.description: The USD/CHF pair attracts some follow-through buying for the fourth straight day, hitting a fresh high since May 2025 during the Asian session on Monday. Bulls now await acceptance above the 0.8300 mark before positioning for further gains amid a supportive fundamental backdrop.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $62.00 amid Fed rate hike odds
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) falls nearly 3.5% after posting modest gains in the previous day, trading around $62.00 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index trades flat at the start of the US NFP week
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) reflects a flat performance at the start of the week. In the Asian trade, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades calmly at around 101.10.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar strengthens above 0.5650 on US-China truce extension
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to around 0.5665 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. Positive developments surrounding US-China talks provide some support to the China-proxy New Zealand Dollar (NZD) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bears await break below 0.7000 ahead of RBA on Tuesday
item.description: The AUD/USD pair steadies just above the 0.7000 psychological mark at the start of a new week, trading near its lowest level since August 4, touched on Friday, as traders opt to wait for the crucial Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) meeting on Tuesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar falls as US-Canada rate gap seen widening further
item.description: USD/CAD extends its gains for the sixth consecutive day, trading around 1.4150 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is declining under pressure from expectations of a widening interest-rate differential between the United States (US) and Canada.

item.title: WTI sticks to modest gains above $92.00 amid Middle East jitters
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on a modest gap-up open on Monday as traders opt to wait for further developments surrounding the Middle East crisis before placing fresh bets.

item.title: Gold tumbles to near $4,200 as hawkish Fed signals and stronger US Dollar pressure bullion
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) drops to around $4,215 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal loses ground as a stronger US Dollar (USD) and hawkish signals from the US Federal Reserve (Fed) policymakers dented bullion's appeal.
